confidence_notes: Food anchors use a Havana cost-of-living index; hostel anchors use monthly citywide averages. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated at roughly two to three times local draft beer. Hotel anchors are broad estimates, and Cuba’s tourist-price variation limits confidence.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and hostel estimates use Havana-specific references. Hotel estimates reflect general knowledge of basic guesthouses and mid-range lodging in Havana.
